Selling in Madison County

Selling a property in Madison County?

Madison County stretches from the Mississippi river towns to fast-growing suburbs like Collinsville, Edwardsville, Troy, and Glen Carbon, with older homes, post-war neighborhoods, and rural properties in between. We buy houses, duplexes, and small multifamily properties throughout the county — including landlords ready to move on, inherited properties, and homes that need significant work.

We buy houses in any situation

Not every sale belongs on the market.

We look at the property in front of us—not a checklist. A direct sale can make sense when a conventional listing adds time, expense, or uncertainty.

  • Inherited property / probate
  • Foreclosure / pre-foreclosure
  • Behind on mortgage payments
  • Divorce
  • Back taxes / tax liens
  • Tired landlord / tenants in place
  • Fire / water / mold damage
  • Foundation problems
  • Hoarder house
  • Vacant property
  • Liens / title issues
  • Job loss / relocation
  • Downsizing / senior move
  • Code violations
  • Expired listing
  • Major repairs / deferred maintenance

Straight answers before you decide.

There is no obligation to accept an offer.

Do I need to repair or clean the property first?

No. ET Real Estate buys properties as-is, so you can leave repairs, unwanted items, and cleanup for us to handle.

How quickly can we close?

A closing can happen in as little as seven days when the title work and details are ready. If you need more time, the closing can be scheduled around your plans.

Are there commissions or hidden fees?

There is no agent commission when you sell directly to ET Real Estate, and we cover the seller’s closing costs. The written offer should spell out the terms clearly before you decide.

What types of property do you buy?

Houses, duplexes, multifamily properties, and apartment buildings in Madison County, Illinois.

Am I required to accept the offer?

No. You can review the offer, ask questions, compare your options, and decide whether a direct sale is right for you.

How is my cash offer calculated?

We look at the property's condition, its location, recent comparable sales, and the cost of any repairs it needs. You get a written cash offer with the terms spelled out, and there is no obligation to accept it.

Can you buy if I'm behind on payments or facing foreclosure?

Yes. Talk to us as early as you can. A direct cash sale can close before a foreclosure sale date, and we can work around your timeline. The sooner we talk, the more options you have.

Do you buy houses with tenants in place?

Yes. We buy rental properties with tenants in place, including tired landlords who want out without evictions, repairs, or showings.

What happens after I fill out the form?

We review the property details, call you to talk through your situation and timeline, visit the property once, and put together a written cash offer. There is no obligation and no pressure at any step.

How fast will I hear back after I fill out the form?

Within 24 hours. We review every inquiry and get back to you within 24 hours with next steps.
